decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is an upgraded version of the established BASIC 518 trommel and has a proven customer base, so it remains a low-cost option on an existing platform that is worth keeping open.
The AK flail shredder series is a core line that was refreshed to EU Stage V engines in 2019, a further commitment showing the firm has already chosen to exercise this option.
The grinder moved from a mention to its own page in 2019, which signals growing commitment, and its prospects are still uncertain while the cost of keeping it is modest, so the option stays open.
The CERON single-shaft pre-shredder generation is promoted as setting standards and already has reported reference installations, so the evidence supports keeping it rather than abandoning it.
